title: May Admin — Unified Administrative Query Layer Specification
status: DESIGN — Specification only. Implementation deferred to Phase 1 Build.
purpose: Define a single administrative lookup interface that wraps all 6 S252 investigation engines, replacing fragmented access across question_history, challenge_registry, investigation_registry, session_registry, and recommendation_registry with a unified admin query surface.
authority: Derived from S252-S258 certified infrastructure. Real field names and data shapes verified against live registries.

sectionsReturned: 1_identity — QID, pack, section, domain, topic, difficulty, cognitive level, state, certification dates
2_content — Stem, choices (A-D), correct choice, explanation (correct + distractor)
3_defects — Defect history, active defect flags, blocked-by-defects status
4_recommendations — Linked REC-IDs with type, severity, status, source scan
5_sessions — Linked sessions with ID, date, mode, title, series, activity
6_challenges — Linked challenges with ID, status, type, resolution
7_certificationHistory — Certification events with batch, session, date
8_readiness — Readiness score, tier, quality verdict from readiness_scoring.json
9_healthSummary — Health score, tier, component breakdown, diagnosis

commands: node scripts/session_intelligence_engine.js --all — All 40 sessions with cross-references
sessionLookup.dataReturned: Session identity, linked QIDs, certified exposure ratios, challenge/recommendation links, investigation references

challengeLookup.dataReturned: Challenge classification (LIKELY_DEFECT/GOVERNANCE_ESCALATION/NEEDS_REVIEW), confidence score, defect code mapping, priority score, routing recommendation

recommendationLookup.access: Direct read or node -e filter on questionIds[]
recommendationLookup.dataReturned: REC-ID, type (REMEDIATE/REVIEW/CERTIFY), severity, status, target QID list, source defect code

investigationLookup.dataReturned: Investigation lifecycle (OPEN→INVESTIGATING→ACTION_REQUIRED→RESOLVED→CLOSED), linked QIDs/challenges/defects/recommendations/sessions, findings array, resolution details

healthLookup.dataReturned: Health score (0-100), tier (HEALTHY/FAIR/NEEDS ATTENTION/CRITICAL), component breakdown (defect/challenge/recommendation/certification/structural/usage), diagnosis

unifiedAdminQueryPattern.description: A future S262+ admin dashboard would present a single search box accepting any entity identifier (QID, CH-ID, INV-ID, REC-ID, sessionId) and routing to the appropriate engine. This specification defines the routing rules.

routingRules.ifPrefixIsP1: Route to question_investigation_api.js — return full 9-section dossier
routingRules.ifPrefixIsCH: Route to challenge_triage_engine.js --challenge=<ID> — return triage + linked QID dossier
routingRules.ifPrefixIsINV: Route to investigation_registry.js --get=<ID> — return investigation + linked entities
routingRules.ifPrefixIsREC: Route to recommendation_registry.json lookup — return REC-ID record + linked QID health summary
routingRules.ifPrefixIsS_orNumeric: Route to session_intelligence_engine.js --session=<ID> — return session intelligence

unifiedAdminQueryPattern.crossReferenceBehavior: Every response includes backlinks: a challenge response includes the linked QID's identity section; a session response includes linked QID states; a recommendation response includes target QID health summaries.
